title: Lightweight & easy to clean
text: Lightweight & easy to clean. Not a soft & comfy beanbag...not a lot of stretch.

product_metadata.title: Big Joe Classic 2pk Bean Bag Chairs, Black Smartmax, 2ft Teardrop
features: COMFORT MEETS STYLE: This kids' bean bag chair is perfect for any place for your little ones to read, play, and just relax in. Available in a variety of fun colors to choose from makes it easy to fit into your space and style.
DURABLE MATERIAL: Designed with our durable, stain-resistant SmartMax fabric, spot cleaning is easily accomplished.
PERFECTLY FILLED: We purposely fill your bean bag with the perfect amount of beans, because we know an over-filled bean bag is not comfy!

IT'S IN THE DETAILS: Double-stitched with dual zippers for extra safety and durability. If you need to open your bean bag, detailed instructions can be found on the warning label attached to your Big Joe.
HOME GROWN: Big Joes are designed and filled in the USA.
description: Okay, who hasn’t wanted a Classic bean chair? Big kids and little ones alike can enjoy a comfy spot made just for them! Simple in design yet perfectly filled for comfort, this bean bag chair is a great fit for a variety of living spaces! Take your pick from a classic round or chic teardrop shape. Designed with a convenient handle makes it easy for little hands to travel to their next adventure.

details.Room Type: Game Recreation Room, Bedroom, Classroom, Library
details.Care instructions: The cover of this chair is designed to last for many years, but sometimes accidents happen. Spot clean your Big Joe as needed.
